environment.description: Tomcat 9.0 servlet container deployed on EC2 instance, directly internet-facing via Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4 only). PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance with db_user having SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE grants on all tables in the public schema. No application-layer proxy or filtering between client and servlet. Security group allows TCP 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14 RDS, user has SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE on public.*
config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user
